analyst_view.overall: Atalanta (12th, 14 points, 4 wins in 11) host Inter (28 points, one behind leader Lazio by Inter's own count) on Sunday night; Sarri's side snapped a four-game winless run with a 1-0 win at Monza but concede too much when opponents overload the flanks and cross, while Chivu's Inter have won four of five and face a busy run of games. Atalanta's back line is the big story the numbers can't see: on Thursday Hien and Kossounou were still training on their own and Kristensen was being judged day by day, so the expected pairing is Scalvini and Kolasinac, with Kessie and Ederson in midfield and Krstovic up front. Inter start Thuram with Pio Esposito, Lautaro is back for the bench after six weeks out, Akanji is not fully fit and Bonny is out (counted by the numbers). Referee Fabio Maresca (4.8 cards a game) and a lively head-to-head are already in the numbers.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.0 goals, already trimming Atalanta a little for recent form and the head-to-head and Inter for Bonny's absence. Atalanta are likely without Hien and Kossounou and probably Kristensen, which the numbers don't know, and Inter's Thuram-Esposito pair with Lautaro to come on should find room; Akanji's doubt for Inter slightly helps Atalanta too. A mild lean up to about 3.1.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.6 corners, already raised for Inter's recent corner count against an Atalanta side conceding many. Atalanta's wide 4-2-3-1 with overlapping full-backs and Inter's wing-backs Dimarco and Spence are their usual way of playing, so nothing new points either way; about 9.6.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.0 cards and already add Maresca's high rate (+26%, 4.8 a game) and a lively head-to-head (+13%). No suspension threat, feud or change of referee has been reported this week, so I stay at about 4.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.8 shots, already lifted 10% for Inter's recent shooting. Atalanta's makeshift centre-backs point up for Inter, but Inter may manage minutes in a busy month and Lautaro only comes off the bench, so the two roughly cancel; about 28.8.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.3 shots on target. With Scalvini and Kolasinac expected in the middle and Hien, Kossounou and probably Kristensen missing, Inter's forwards should get cleaner looks than the numbers assume, and Atalanta put 37% of their shots on target; a small nudge to about 9.6.
